title.en: AC through resistor, inductor and capacitor
title.kn: ರೋಧಕ, ಪ್ರೇರಕ ಮತ್ತು ಧಾರಕದ ಮೂಲಕ AC

hook.en: Connect a resistor, a coil and a capacitor in turn to the same AC supply. The current changes in size and also shifts in time. Why?
hook.kn: ಒಂದೇ AC ಸರಬರಾಜಿಗೆ ರೋಧಕ, ಸುರುಳಿ ಮತ್ತು ಧಾರಕವನ್ನು ಒಂದೊಂದಾಗಿ ಜೋಡಿಸಿ. ಪ್ರವಾಹದ ಗಾತ್ರ ಮಾತ್ರವಲ್ಲ, ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲೂ ಸ್ಥಳಾಂತರವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಏಕೆ?

objectives.en: State the phase relation between V and I in R, L and C
Explain why a capacitor blocks DC and an inductor passes it

narration.en: Connect a resistor, a coil and a capacitor in turn to the same AC supply. The current changes in size and also shifts in time. Why?
narration.kn: ಒಂದೇ AC ಸರಬರಾಜಿಗೆ ರೋಧಕ, ಸುರುಳಿ ಮತ್ತು ಧಾರಕವನ್ನು ಒಂದೊಂದಾಗಿ ಜೋಡಿಸಿ. ಪ್ರವಾಹದ ಗಾತ್ರ ಮಾತ್ರವಲ್ಲ, ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲೂ ಸ್ಥಳಾಂತರವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಏಕೆ?

body.en: In a pure resistor the current is in phase with the voltage: $i = (V_m/R) \sin ωt$. Ohm's law holds with RMS values, $I = V/R$, and the average power is $P = V_{rms} I_{rms}$. Resistance does not depend on frequency.
body.kn: ಶುದ್ಧ ರೋಧಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಭವಾಂತರ ಒಂದೇ ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿರುತ್ತವೆ. RMS ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳಿಗೆ I = V/R. ರೋಧ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಅವಲಂಬಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

narration.en: In a pure resistor the current is in phase with the voltage: i = (Vm/R) sin ωt. Ohm's law holds with RMS values, I = V/R, and the average power is P = Vrms Irms. Resistance does not depend on frequency.
narration.kn: ಶುದ್ಧ ರೋಧಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಭವಾಂತರ ಒಂದೇ ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿರುತ್ತವೆ. RMS ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳಿಗೆ I = V/R. ರೋಧ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಅವಲಂಬಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

title.en: On the board: R, L and C with AC

say.en: Let us compare the voltage and current phasors in a pure resistor, a pure inductor and a pure capacitor.
In an inductor the current lags the voltage by 90 degrees. Its opposition is XL equal to 2 pi f L.
In a capacitor the current leads the voltage by 90 degrees. Its opposition is XC equal to 1 over 2 pi f C.
Now plot opposition against frequency. XL rises in a straight line, XC falls along a curve, and R stays flat.
Example: a 0.1 henry coil at 50 hertz. XL is 2 pi times 50 times 0.1, which is 31.4 ohms. Note that a pure L or C uses no power.

text.en: Power in L or C: zero

body.en: An inductor opposes AC by its inductive reactance $X_L = 2πfL$ (ohms). The current lags the voltage by 90°. $X_L$ rises with frequency, and is zero for DC, so a coil passes DC but chokes high-frequency AC. The average power in a pure inductor is zero.
body.kn: ಪ್ರೇರಕವು XL = 2πfL ಪ್ರೇರಕ ಪ್ರತಿಘಾತದಿಂದ AC ಯನ್ನು ವಿರೋಧಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರವಾಹ ವಿಭವಾಂತರಕ್ಕಿಂತ 90° ಹಿಂದುಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಆವೃತ್ತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾದಂತೆ XL ಹೆಚ್ಚು; DC ಗೆ ಶೂನ್ಯ. ಸರಾಸರಿ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ಶೂನ್ಯ.

narration.en: An inductor opposes AC by its inductive reactance XL = 2πfL (ohms). The current lags the voltage by 90°. XL rises with frequency, and is zero for DC, so a coil passes DC but chokes high-frequency AC. The average power in a pure inductor is zero.
narration.kn: ಪ್ರೇರಕವು XL = 2πfL ಪ್ರೇರಕ ಪ್ರತಿಘಾತದಿಂದ AC ಯನ್ನು ವಿರೋಧಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರವಾಹ ವಿಭವಾಂತರಕ್ಕಿಂತ 90° ಹಿಂದುಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಆವೃತ್ತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾದಂತೆ XL ಹೆಚ್ಚು; DC ಗೆ ಶೂನ್ಯ. ಸರಾಸರಿ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ಶೂನ್ಯ.

body.en: A capacitor opposes AC by its capacitive reactance $X_C = 1/(2πfC)$. The current leads the voltage by 90°. $X_C$ falls as frequency rises and is infinite for DC, so a capacitor blocks DC but passes AC. The average power is zero.
body.kn: ಧಾರಕವು XC = 1/(2πfC) ಧಾರಕ ಪ್ರತಿಘಾತದಿಂದ AC ಯನ್ನು ವಿರೋಧಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರವಾಹ ವಿಭವಾಂತರಕ್ಕಿಂತ 90° ಮುನ್ನಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. DC ಗೆ XC ಅನಂತ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಧಾರಕ DC ತಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: A capacitor opposes AC by its capacitive reactance XC = 1/(2πfC). The current leads the voltage by 90°. XC falls as frequency rises and is infinite for DC, so a capacitor blocks DC but passes AC. The average power is zero.
narration.kn: ಧಾರಕವು XC = 1/(2πfC) ಧಾರಕ ಪ್ರತಿಘಾತದಿಂದ AC ಯನ್ನು ವಿರೋಧಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರವಾಹ ವಿಭವಾಂತರಕ್ಕಿಂತ 90° ಮುನ್ನಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. DC ಗೆ XC ಅನಂತ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಧಾರಕ DC ತಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: In a Capacitor, I comes before V (current leads). V comes before I in an inductor L (current lags). Read the word: C-I-V, then V-I-L.

narration.en: CIVIL. In a Capacitor, I comes before V (current leads). V comes before I in an inductor L (current lags). Read the word: C-I-V, then V-I-L.

mnemonic.en: CIVIL: C I V … V I L

caption.en: Choose L, C and a frequency. Yellow is XL, green is XC; read both at your chosen frequency.

tryThis.en: Double f: XL doubles and XC halves.
Make C bigger: XC falls, so a big capacitor passes even low frequencies.
Find where the two curves cross; that is the resonant frequency of the next lessons.

narration.en: Choose L, C and a frequency. Yellow is XL, green is XC; read both at your chosen frequency. Double f: XL doubles and XC halves. Make C bigger: XC falls, so a big capacitor passes even low frequencies. Find where the two curves cross; that is the resonant frequency of the next lessons.
